 John Cena returns to Raw in preparation for The John Cena Classic

 Tonight John Cena returns to Raw en route to The John Cena Classic.
 Cena has already invited the likes of Cody Rhodes, Zilla Fatu, NXT Women’s Champion Kelani Jordan, Fatal Influence and Charlotte Flair.
 Who will The Greatest of All Time select next? Find out tonight live on Raw at 8 ET/5 PT on Netflix.
